newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks seen mixed ahead of budget.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks seen mixed ahead of budget.

text.p: Pakistan stocks are likely to open mixed on Thursday in selective trade ahead of the 1997/98 (July-June) budget due on June 14, dealers said.
"There is some selective buying in blue chips that have hit attractive levels but overall investors are cautious and are unlikely to move in," a dealer at a foreign brokerage house said.

On Wednesday, the Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index rose 2.59 points, or 0.17 percent, to end at 1,502.32. Losers led gainers 204 to 92. Turnover rose to 24 million shares from 15 million in the previous session.
